items.name: Voidfarers
items.desc: For this civilization, the journey is the destination. Abandoning permanent settlement in favor of life aboard vast Arkships, they carry their people, industry, and ambitions across the stars.

items.name: The Sacred Path
items.desc: §RWARNING: Disables ['concept_arkship_settling']§!\n\nThese nomadic spiritualists traverse a deified route dictated by their ancestral scriptures. With technological advancements and an evolving understanding of the galaxy, will the Pilgrimage remain their purpose?

items.name: Heirs of the Khan
items.desc: §RWARNING: Disables ['concept_arkship_settling']§!\n\nOnce the next in line of the Khanate, this clan was cast down by treachery. Betrayed by those they considered kin, they now stalk the hyperlanes as nomads, gathering their strength to one day return the favor.

- Nomadic Origin
- Periodically chased by §RHostile§! Marauder ships
- May become the Khan, if they can survive
- Can Create §YSatrapy§! Vassals

items.name: Forever Cruise
items.desc: §RWARNING: Disables ['concept_arkship_settling']§!\n\nThe Forever Cruise travels the stars in search of wonder and excitement, where the birth of nebulae can be observed from the comfort of a sun lounger. The dedicated crew works tirelessly to cater to any passenger whim.

items.name: Red Giant
items.desc: This civilization is at a crossroads: the Red Giant at the heart of its system is warming up their planet, threatening to cook them alive.\n\nCan they adapt until the cause is found and fixed, or will they decide to embrace the heat, capitalizing on these strange and perhaps unnatural changes?

items.desc: This civilization did not rise; it was released. As the stasis pods unlocked, they awakened to a world aged beyond recognition. Yet all is not lost. Scattered beneath dust and ruin across the galaxy, their past endures, waiting to be rediscovered.

items.name: Mindwardens
items.desc:
§RWARNING: Challenging Origin§!
§RWARNING: Blocks access to ['concept_psionic_ascension'].§!

This civilization's ancestors were plagued by otherworldly forces that invaded the mind, inspiring them to dedicate great effort and resources into developing anti-psionic technology.

Their ancient devices are still functional, but remain untested against psionic threats from the wider galaxy.

items.name: Endbringers
items.desc:
§RWARNING: Challenging Origin§!
§RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_psionic_ascension'].§!

This civilization has been long-obsessed with a mysterious calamity which turned a neighboring planet into a desolate and shrouded world. Now, as they take to the stars, they can finally explore its secrets and find out if a similar fate awaits them too.

items.name: Evolutionary Predators
items.desc: §RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_mutation_ascension'].§!\n\nThis species has always hunted the most unique creatures, driven by an instinct they didn't fully understand. Possessing a rare ability to integrate the genetics of their prey, it evolved into the apex predator of its world, absorbing every genetic advantage available. Now, their hunger leads them to the stars.

items.name: Starlit Citadel
items.desc: A mysterious portal looms at the edge of this civilization's home system, a gateway from which hostile entities emerge in relentless waves. These invasions are as unpredictable as they are inevitable, forcing the people to rely on their greatest technological triumph - the §HDeep Space Citadel§!.

items.name: Wilderness
items.desc: §RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_purity_ascension'].§!\n\nThis entity is nothing less than a sapient ecosphere: a multitude of diverse lifeforms which long since coalesced to form a gestalt consciousness on a planetary scale.

items.desc: Instilled with a thirst for adventure, this civilization is ready to set forth on their greatest and most challenging expedition. Armed only with a mysterious map, they now race across the stars to secure a legendary pirate treasure.

items.desc: The rustle of bladed grass. The roaring silence of the night. The will of the hunter, sharp and cold as starlight...\n\nThis civilization has a primal connection to the wild. Viewing themselves as stewards to the diverse (and often deadly) wildlife native to their world, they now turn their gaze skyward. Masters of animal handling and ranching, this relationship with fauna has developed according to their ethics. How this bond will evolve on a galactic scale remains to be seen.

items.name: Calamitous Birth
items.desc: Not native to their 'homeworld', these Lithoids arrived when a meteorite slammed into the planet and killed off most of the native life.
items.effects:
- Homeworld:
    - ['concept_massive_crater']
    - ['concept_buried_lithoids']: +4
- Available Colony Ships: §YLithoid Meteorites§!
- Planets Colonized with §YLithoid Meteorites§!:
    - §Y£blocker£ Buried Lithoids§!: +2
    - Colony Modifiers: ['concept_lithoid_crater']
- Available Holdings: ['concept_experimental_crater', £building£ Experimental Crater] on (Subject) colonies

items.name: Life-Seeded
items.desc: This civilization's home is a paradise, possibly designed just for them.
items.effects: - Homeworld: ['concept_pc_gaia'] (Size: £planetsize£ 30) with §IRare Planetary Features§!\n- Species Traits: ['concept_gaia_preference']

items.name: Post-Apocalyptic
items.desc: Baptized by nuclear fire, this civilization has faced total annihilation - and survived. Devastated yet unbroken, they have rebuilt civilization from the ashes of their old world.
items.effects: - Homeworld: ['concept_pc_nuked']\n- Species Traits: ['concept_survivor']

items.name: Radioactive Rovers
items.desc: In the aftermath of a devastating nuclear disaster, these machines emerged as the sole survivors of a once-flourishing civilization. By continuing to fulfill their designated purpose, they gradually rebuilt society from the uninhabitable ashes of their old world.
items.effects: - Homeworld: ['concept_pc_nuked']\n- Species Traits: ['concept_robot_survivor']

items.name: Clone Army
items.desc: A species of short-lived and infertile soldier clones exceptionally proficient in matters of war, left masterless and alone to question their engineered purpose and uncertain fate.
items.effects:
- Homeworld: ['concept_clone_army_clone_vat']: +2 
- Species Traits: ['concept_clone_soldier_infertile']
- Additional Starting Technologies: 
    - ['concept_cloning', £society_research£ Cloning] 
    - ['concept_gene_banks', £society_research£ Gene Banks]

items.name: Resource Consolidation
items.desc: This Machine Intelligence has long-since consolidated all resources in their home system into their capital world, covering it entirely with machinery.
items.effects:
- Homeworld:
    - ['concept_prototype_pc_machine']
    - Planetary Features: ['concept_consolidated_resources'] 
    - If combined with the §IDriven Assimilator§! Civic:
        - Planetary Features: ['concept_organic_slurry']
- Waives §YTechnology§! requirements for the §YMachine Worlds§! Ascension Perk

items.name: Hard Reset
items.desc: §RWARNING: Challenging Origin§!\n\nAbruptly severed from the Machine that assimilated them, this nascent civilization has fought fiercely to establish its own presence in the galaxy.
items.effects:
- Homeworld:
    - Colony Modifiers: ['concept_unplugged_battlefield']
- Home System: Contains a ['concept_pc_nuked'] with an ['concept_archaeology_site'] related to a decimated ['concept_preftl_civilizations', Pre-FTL Civilization]
- Species Traits:
    - Limited access to ['concept_cybernetic_traits'] Traits
    - ['concept_unplugged_cybernetic_positives_3']
    - ['concept_unplugged_cybernetic_negatives_3']

items.name: Mechanist
items.desc: This civilization has been preoccupied with the idea of metallic automatons since the early Steam Age. Although many said it could not be done, the first true robots left the assembly lines long before even rudimentary space flight was achieved.
items.effects:
- ['concept_robots', £mod_planet_jobs_robotic_produces_mult£ Robot] £pop£ §HPops§!: 800
    - Mechanical Trait: ['concept_adaptive_frames']
- Homeworld: ['concept_robot_assembly_plant',£building£ Robot Assembly Plant]
- Additional Starting Technologies:
    - ['concept_powered_exoskeletons', £engineering_research£ Powered Exoskeletons]
    - ['concept_robotic_workers', £engineering_research£ Artificial Workforce]
- Guaranteed Research Options: ['concept_robomodding', £engineering_research£ Machine Template System]

items.name: Syncretic Evolution
items.desc: A second species forms an integral part of this civilization. They are big, strong, and most of them have the intelligence of a particularly dim-witted child. Ancient wars have culled their species of their most aggressive tendencies, leaving them quite servile.
items.effects: - £pop£ §IOrganic Pops§! with ['concept_syncretic_proles'] Trait: 2.4K

items.name: Tree of Life
items.desc: This Hive evolved in a symbiotic relationship with a vast Tree. The Tree grants them many benefits, but its loss would cripple them.
items.effects:
- Homeworld: ['concept_tree_of_life']
- Colonized Planets: ['concept_tree_of_life_sapling'] Planetary Feature
- Colonies without the §YTree of Life Sapling§!: ['concept_transplant_tree_of_life'] Colony Decision
- Available Holdings: ['concept_tree_of_life_holding', £building£ Tree of Life Sprout] on Subject colonies

items.name: Fruitful Partnership
items.desc: This verdant civilization has developed a unique synergy with spaceborne fauna. By offering their fruits to these creatures, they entice the seed dispersers to aid their colonization efforts.
items.effects:
- Space Fauna: Disperse ['concept_seed_pod', Seed Pods] throughout the galaxy 
- Available Starbase Buildings: ['concept_sm_feeder', Starseed Gardens] 
- Available Bombardment Stances: ['concept_seed_bombing' ]
- Home System: ['concept_tiyanki' ] in a neighboring system

items.name: Galactic Doorstep
items.desc: This civilization has a dormant §HGateway§! in their home system - potential technological benefit, or a looming menace?
items.effects: - Home System: Dormant ['concept_gateway']
items.possible: is_nomadic = no

items.name: Lost Colony
items.desc: This civilization originated as a lost and forgotten colony, separated from its homeworld long ago. The struggling colonists endured many hardships before they could build up the necessary technological and industrial base that would allow for a return to space.
items.effects: - Starting Planet: ['concept_colonial_spirit'] Planetary Modifier\n- An ['concept_advanced_empire'] of the same species is present in the galaxy

items.name: Elder Race
items.desc: This civilization greatly predates the current generation of galactic powers. Eons of stagnation gradually reduced their empire to a mere shadow of what it once was.
items.effects: - No effect

items.name: Elder Race
items.desc: This civilization greatly predates the current generation of galactic powers. Eons of stagnation gradually reduced their empire to a mere shadow of what it once was.
items.effects: - No effect

items.name: Enlightened
items.desc: The natural development of this civilization was greatly accelerated by the interference of another party, who helped them become a spacefaring culture.

items.name: Developing Civilization
items.desc: This civilization has yet to become spacefaring, however with a little encouragement or a great deal of time they may yet become an actor on the galactic stage.
items.effects: - No effect

items.name: Separatists
items.desc: This civilization came into being when it rebelled and seceded from another empire.

items.name: Liberated
items.desc: This civilization came into being after being liberated from another empire.

items.name: Daemonic Incursion
items.desc: Lead by a corrupted champion, this empire emerged from a dimensional portal and has vowed to lay waste to this reality.

items.name: Khanate Successor
items.desc: This civilization arose out of the ashes of the Great Khan's mighty empire.
items.effects: Unlocks the §YRaiding§! bombardment stance, which in turn allows us to abduct pops from besieged planets and resettle them to our own worlds.

items.name: Life-Seeded
items.desc: This civilization's home is a paradise, possibly designed just for them.
items.effects: - Homeworld: ['concept_pc_gaia'] (Size: £planetsize£ 30) with §IRare Planetary Features§!\n- Species Traits: ['concept_gaia_preference']

items.name: Common Ground
items.desc: This civilization established early contact with their immediate alien neighbors. Finding strength in their differences, they soon decided to face the future, and whatever it might bring, together.
items.effects: - Start as a member of a non-§HHegemony§! federation with two additional members

items.name: Hegemon Subordinate
items.desc: This civilization established early contact with their immediate alien neighbors. Gradually, over the span of a century, they were subordinated to one of those neighbors, who masterminded the birth of an interstellar union with them as its leader.
items.effects: - Start as a member of a §HHegemony§! federation with two additional members.

items.name: Imperial Liege
items.desc: An ambitious overlord who has spent considerable time and efforts in subduing their closest neighbors to serve their every need. They are slowly growing more indolent as they devolve more and more responsibility to their vassals.
items.effects: - Starts as an §HAdvanced Empire§!\n- Starts with several vassals

items.name: Your Ladder To The Sky
items.desc: From the moment the Board of Directors at Minamar Specialized Industries first delivered our civilization to the stars, we have understood that the galaxy was too beautiful not to be shared. Since then, we have worked tirelessly to help less developed civilizations achieve FTL travel.\n\nEnlightenment may not be free. But at MSI, it is always worth the cost.
items.effects: - Starts as an §HAdvanced Empire§!\n- Start with a number of enslaved £pop£ §HPops§! abducted from §HPre-FTL Civilizations§! across the galaxy.\n- Allows the §HRaiding§! bombardment stance, which abducts £pop£ §HPops§! from planets and resettles them to your colonies.

items.name: Planetary Purgers
items.desc: A temporary nomadic government overseeing worlds as they are purged of planetbound life.
items.effects: §YA temporary empire which funnel all their resources from purging back to their Overlord§!

items.name: Planetfallen
items.desc: This empire was founded by the settlement of the population of an Arkship onto a new world.
items.effects: No effects

items.name: Voidroamers
items.desc: The remains of a nomadic civilization, left to roam the stars while ruled from a new world.
items.effects: No effects
